Before the exam starts

How to fill in your bubble sheet

Pencil, version letter, student number, and your answers.

Welcome. Before the exam starts, take two minutes to see how to fill in the bubble sheet correctly. Mistakes on the sheet are the easiest points to lose.

The basics

Use a pencil

For your name, your version letter, your student number, and every answer.

No pens.

Pencil only, for everything on the sheet and the exam booklet. The scanner reads pencil marks, and pencil can be erased if you change an answer.

Top of the sheet

Write your version letter and your name

1

2

1

Version letter

Write your exam's version letter in the empty space at the top.

2

Your name

Print your name clearly and correctly on the Student Name line.

The version letter goes in an empty space at the top of the sheet, and your name goes on the Student Name line. The highlighted boxes show where. Print your name so it can be read.

Student number

Fill in your student number 

You have 2 options:

7 digits

Your student ID in boxes 1 to 7. Leave boxes 8 and 9 empty.

9 digits

Add 0 0 at the start, then your 7-digit ID, in boxes 1 to 9.

Fill in the bubble beside each box too. Writing the digits is not enough.

Either format works: the seven-digit student ID, or the ID with two zeros in front to make nine digits. The key point is to fill in the bubbles to the right of each box, one bubble for each digit.

Here is what the bubbles look like for a made-up ID, 1234567. On the left, the seven-digit version: one bubble per row for rows 1 to 7, rows 8 and 9 left empty. On the right, two zeros first, then the seven digits, using all nine rows. One filled bubble per row either way.

Your answers

Fill each bubble dark and full

Don't

Too faint

Press firmly so the mark is dark, not light.

Don't

Only a dot

Fill in the whole bubble, not just part of it.

Do

Dark and full

Fill the whole bubble with a firm, dark mark.

Three examples. A faint mark, a mark that only covers part of the bubble, and the right way: a dark mark that fills the whole bubble. Press firmly with the pencil.

Erase the old mark fully, then fill in your new answer.

If you change your mind, erase the old answer completely. Do not cross it out. Then fill in the bubble for your new answer.

Choose your single best answer and fill in that one bubble.

One bubble per question. If you are torn between two answers, pick the one you think is best.

Before you begin

Your bubble sheet checklist

Pencil only

For your name, version letter, student number and answers.

Version letter

Written in the empty space at the top of the sheet.

Name

Printed clearly and correctly on the Student Name line.

Student number

7 digits, or 0 0 plus 7 digits, with every bubble filled.

Dark, full bubbles

Press firmly and fill the whole bubble.

Mistakes

Erase completely. Never cross out.

One answer

Only one bubble filled for each question.

Clean sheet

No stray marks. The sheet says they may count against you.

A quick checklist to run through before you start. Take a moment to check each item on your own sheet.
